sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the DIRECT_STATIC requirement: it targets the declared owners, preserves the table-selected thresholds and units, enforces the conditional boolean evidence and termination alternatives, and uses inclusive <=250 mm applicability without unconditional conditional-field presence.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The candidate omits declared DIRECT_STATIC obligations in the COMPLETE dependency contract and normalized requirement. Add the framing owner/path model and constraints for framingIceStrengtheningAboveUpperIceWaterline and framingIceStrengtheningBelowLowerIceWaterline, including the IA Super versus IA/IB/IC table-selected thresholds by hullRegion and the required units, plus the conditional upperBowIceBeltRequired-to-reachesUpperBowIceBeltTop requirement. Preserve the termination-case rule, its adjacent-boundary alternatives, and the <=250 mm inclusive comparison.

Repair the termination-case constraints and preserve the prior table obligations. Add a datatype-constrained shape for iceStrengtheningTerminationAtAdjacentBoundaryPermitted (xsd:boolean) on each framingIceStrengtheningTerminationCase; the current SPARQL-only use permits malformed values, especially when the extension exceeds 250 mm. Keep the <=250 mm inclusive condition requiring that property to be true, while avoiding an unconditional presence requirement when the condition is not applicable. Also do not require reachesTankTopOrBelowFloorTop on every frame: it is only relevant to the bow branch of the Table 4-6 lower-extent rule; retain the conditional failure for an applicable bow case when the required true evidence is absent. Preserve the IA Super versus IA/IB/IC thresholds, hull-region selection, units, upper-bow conditional, termination-boundary alternatives, and correct owner/path structure.

The upperBowIceBeltRequired conditional is not enforced: the nested sh:property is evaluated against the boolean value true, not against the frame node, so upperBowIceBeltRequired=true can pass without reachesUpperBowIceBeltTop=true. Replace this ineffective nested constraint with a frame-level SHACL SPARQL constraint (or equivalent same-node constraint) that fails when upperBowIceBeltRequired is true and reachesUpperBowIceBeltTop is not true, while preserving the existing boolean datatype and conditional applicability.

The candidate faithfully encodes the DIRECT_STATIC requirement: it targets the declared owners, preserves the table-selected thresholds and units, enforces the conditional boolean evidence and termination alternatives, and uses inclusive <=250 mm applicability without unconditional conditional-field presence.
